research_notes: Initial research 2026-10-01: official frozen occupations, personal biography, first parliamentary speech, government-hosted SDA speech, public indexed professional profile, contemporary university calendar, employer annual report and reliable interview checked. All six official occupations retained; no employer inferred from occupation alone.

Retail chronology conflict: frozen Handbook gives 1994–1999 overall retail work; first speech recalls losing work aged 19 after five years, and 2026 interview repeats the five-year account. Do not convert ages to exact dates or assume uninterrupted Toys R Us service through 1999. Retrieve industrial commission decision/reinstatement details and legal employing company in follow-up.

Psychology employer lead: indexed LinkedIn identifies Northern Division of General Practice 2005–2007. The Adelaide Northern organisation later used Northern Health Network and Sonder names; 2012–2013 annual report gives earlier history and distinct 2013 staff transfer. Neither later corporate form nor Commonwealth grants prove her payroll entity, ownership/control in 2005–2007 or full-time hours.

Education is not employment: psychology degrees at Flinders and Adelaide retained in source trail. University research-assistant employer and student-union remuneration remain unverified. Searches for those appointments and division annual reports did not recover a contemporaneous personal staff/contract record.

Recovered source-access errors: APH member page and Flinders calendar direct opens returned 403 Forbidden; LinkedIn returned 999 Unknown Status Code. Frozen records, indexed public material and reproduced Hansard used. No job-wide blocking error.

Follow-up: research-assistant employer, legal division identity and historical governance, exact psychology/training hours and overlap, retail interruption/reinstatement dates, student office remuneration, and whether swimming instruction included paid work separate from volunteering. Last follow-up 2026-10-01; next Anne Ruston.

Follow-up2026-10-02: first-person2008House speech identifies Seacliff volunteer organisation and Christies Beach membership begun2008. Generic volunteer hours in same speech are not personal paid/full-time evidence.

Targeted FWC/Toys R Us, Sonder/Northern Division, Flinders research-assistant and university-president searches did not resolve legal employers, appointment hours or reinstatement case. Josh Peak retrospective1999dismissal date logged as conflict lead only. Original industrial commission decision and2005–07division staff records remain preferred next avenues.

A multi-speaker FRSA conference result juxtaposes Rishworth with a research-assistant biography belonging elsewhere; no Murdoch Childrens position assigned. Ministerial interviews repeat broad psychology experience without employer evidence. All outstanding payroll/control/FT and chronology gaps retained.

Follow-up2026-10-03: targeted searches for the Toys R Us Industrial Relations Commission matter, including AustLII/reinstatement variants, returned the already captured first-person account and later SDA/Future Women retellings but no original decision, case number or employing-company name. Northern Division and Flinders research-assistant searches likewise repeated the public profile without payroll or hours evidence. No exact break or reinstatement date was inferred.
